additional_info.subject: RE: ID0401254-DC/Si-D/DE[Y2/S5 313702352003] Technical query CRM:01811000607
additional_info.body:
Hi Rudolf,
We have investigated the logs over the period of 1Week.
We couldn't find the charging session on the said chargers.
Upon further investigation, We have checked all the chargers are on v5.0.21.
FW v5.0.21 is unstable, We highly recommend updating the charger to stable v6.0.3.
Do let us know if you have any other query.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"
